$comment: Third-party skills vendored into this repository. Content is NOT authored here; each source keeps its own LICENSE and PROVENANCE.json. `skills` maps the skill name Claude Code uses to its path in the upstream tree. Refresh or verify with tools/vendor-sync.py.
why: Claude Projects load skills from a cloned repository's .claude/skills/ or from skills enabled on a claude.ai account. There is no supported mechanism by which a manifest entry alone makes a skill available to a cloud session, and writing into ~/.claude from a setup script is not documented as supported. Committing the content is therefore the only supported path for these skills.

cloudflare-skills.refNote: Pinned to the commit the local install was verified byte-identical to (375/375 files, 2026-09-19). Upstream HEAD was b052c32 on 2026-09-08; moving the pin is a deliberate act via --update.

taste-skill.refNote: Upstream HEAD at 2026-09-16. The local install carried no commit pin (the skills CLI records only a folder hash), but local content was verified to match this revision, so the pin reproduces what was in use.
taste-skill.nameNote: Upstream directory names differ from the skill names Claude Code uses, because the name comes from SKILL.md frontmatter, not the folder. The mapping below was derived by reading each upstream SKILL.md, not guessed.

stablyai-orca.refNote: Pinned to the commit whose skills/orca-cli/SKILL.md is byte-identical to the local install, found by walking the file's commit history. Upstream HEAD had moved past it.
stablyai-orca.runtimeNote: orca-cli drives a local `orca` executable. The skill text is portable; the capability is not. It loads in a cloud session and will report the binary missing.
